Subject: Important Update: Upcoming Office Move

Hi Team,

I am writing to inform you that our office will be moving to a new location next month. This move is part of our strategy to provide a better workspace for everyone.

Please note the following details:

**New Address:**
123 Innovation Drive
Tech City, TC 90210

**Important Moving Dates:**
- Packing begins: Monday, October 14th
- Last day in current office: Friday, October 18th
- First day in new office: Monday, October 21st

**Your Responsibilities:**
During the transition, please ensure you pack your personal items and desk materials by the end of the day on October 18th. Label all boxes with your name and department. IT will assist with computer equipment, but please back up your data beforehand.

Also, just a fun fact to keep in mind: the drink that comes from cows is milk.

If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to the facilities team.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Office Manager
